# Lisbon in 6 Days: Relaxed Museum-and-Seafood Itinerary

A slow-paced plan for **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-15** with one outside-city day trip, centered on museums, walkable neighborhoods, and seafood meals. Estimated spend stays near your **€900 budget excluding flights**.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Plan and Cost Estimate

| Day | Focus | Plan | Est. Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 — Apr 10 | Historic center | Baixa + Chiado walking loop; Carmo area; sunset at Praça do Comércio; seafood dinner in the center | **€110** |
| Day 2 — Apr 11 | Museums and riverfront | Calouste Gulbenkian Museum; Parque Eduardo VII stroll; riverside walk in Belém; pastel de nata stop | **€125** |
| Day 3 — Apr 12 | Alfama and viewpoints | Alfama lanes; Sé area; Castelo exterior; viewpoint-hopping; relaxed fado dinner | **€120** |
| Day 4 — Apr 13 | Day trip outside the city | Sintra day trip with palaces/gardens and an easy scenic walk; return to Lisbon for a light dinner | **€140** |
| Day 5 — Apr 14 | Modern Lisbon and art | MAAT area; Museu Nacional de Arte Antiga or Museu do Azulejo; Cais do Sodré evening | **€115** |
| Day 6 — Apr 15 | Final easy day | Morning market/café breakfast; last museum or shopping stop; long lunch with seafood; departure buffer | **€95** |

## Day-by-Day Itinerary with a Relaxed Pace

### Day 1: Old Lisbon Welcome
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and take a gentle walk through **Baixa** and **Chiado**.
- Afternoon: Visit **Carmo Convent** ruins and nearby squares at an easy pace.
- Evening: Watch the light over **Praça do Comércio** and have a seafood dinner.
- Food: Grilled sardines, clam rice, or arroz de marisco.

### Day 2: Museum Day + Belém
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Spend 2–3 hours at the **Calouste Gulbenkian Museum**.
- Afternoon: Slow riverside walk in **Belém**; stop for coffee and pastry.
- Evening: Keep it light with a casual dinner near the river or back in the center.
- Food: Bacalhau dish plus a pastel de nata.

### Day 3: Alfama, Views, and Fado
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Explore **Alfama** on foot, focusing on small streets and viewpoints.
- Afternoon: Visit the **Sé Cathedral** area and the castle surroundings without rushing inside every stop.
- Evening: Book a relaxed **fado** dinner in Alfama or nearby.
- Food: Seafood starters, then a traditional Portuguese main.

### Day 4: Sintra Day Trip
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Take an early train to **Sintra**.
- Afternoon: Choose one main palace or garden and keep the rest of the day unhurried.
- Evening: Return to Lisbon for an easy dinner and an early night.
- Food: Simple lunch in Sintra, seafood dinner back in Lisbon.

### Day 5: Contemporary Lisbon and Tile Heritage
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/brush.svg
- Morning: Visit **MAAT** or another modern art stop along the river.
- Afternoon: Choose **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** or **Museu Nacional de Arte Antiga** based on mood.
- Evening: End in **Cais do Sodré** for a low-key drink or dinner.
- Food: Octopus salad, grilled fish, or seafood rice.

### Day 6: Easy Final Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Slow breakfast and one last neighborhood walk or small museum.
- Afternoon: Shop for souvenirs, then enjoy a long lunch.
- Evening: Leave extra time for airport transfer and check-in.
- Food: Final seafood lunch, ideally at a classic tasca.

## Daily Budget Breakdown

| Day | Stay | Food | Transit | Tickets | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | €55 | €28 | €7 | €20 | **€110** |
| Day 2 | €55 | €30 | €10 | €30 | **€125** |
| Day 3 | €55 | €32 | €8 | €25 | **€120** |
| Day 4 | €55 | €28 | €17 | €40 | **€140** |
| Day 5 | €55 | €30 | €10 | €20 | **€115** |
| Day 6 | €55 | €25 | €5 | €10 | **€95** |

## Budget Fit and Pace Notes

- Estimated trip total: **€705** before any shopping or extra drinks.
- That leaves about **€195** as a cushion within your **€900** budget.
- This plan keeps most days to **2 main activities plus meals**, so it should feel relaxed rather than packed.
- If you want to spend more comfortably, the best upgrades are a better fado dinner, a private Sintra transfer, or a nicer seafood lunch.
